_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Repeated Loads Design Criteria Report
summary: Describes the spectrum of loads the aircraft store will encounter across its operational service life, used to calculate the store's fatigue life and verify system performance requirements.
use_relationship:
The Repeated Loads Design Criteria Report describes the spectrum of loads the aircraft store will encounter across its operational service life. The data will be used in the calculation of the store's fatigue life in order to verify the store has met the system performance requirements in the specified operational environment.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described by the contract SOW.

This DID supersedes DI-SESS-82232.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Repeated Loads Criteria Report shall contain the following:

children.title: Maneuver loads spectra and the derivation thereof
Distribution of applied in-flight loads at the carriage station
children.content: Describe the airplane weight, altitudes, speed, symmetrical and unsymmetrical load factors, variable geometry positions and configurations to substantiate the data.

children.title: Distributions of applied ground loads due to the landing gear
children.content: Distributions of applied ground loads due to the landing gear, arresting hook, catapult launch bar, catapult holdback structure and airframe response loads for landing, taxiing, takeoff, and ground handling conditions.

children.title: Details of analyses methods with sample calculations as appropriate
